title: I was wondering if…: lùi thì để lịch sự
summary: Dùng quá khứ và tiếp diễn để nói nhẹ nhàng, lịch sự hơn: I was wondering, I was hoping, I'd hoped, I wanted to ask.

dialogue.en: Hi, Ms. Lan. Do you have a minute?
dialogue.vi: Chào chị Lan. Chị có rảnh một chút không?

dialogue.en: [[I was wondering if]] I could leave early on Friday.
dialogue.vi: Em đang tự hỏi liệu thứ Sáu em có thể về sớm không.

dialogue.en: Hmm. [[I was hoping]] you'd finish the report first.
dialogue.vi: Ừm. Chị cũng mong em làm xong báo cáo trước.

dialogue.en: [[I'd hoped]] to finish it on Thursday, actually.
dialogue.vi: Thật ra em đã định xong vào thứ Năm.

dialogue.en: OK. [[I was going to]] suggest that anyway.
dialogue.vi: Được. Chị cũng định đề nghị vậy.

sections.heading: Quá khứ cho hiện tại: nhẹ nhàng hơn
sections.rule: Dùng **quá khứ** (và **quá khứ tiếp diễn**) để nói về **hiện tại** một cách **lịch sự, ít áp đặt**: I wanted, I was wondering, I was hoping.

head: Trực tiếp
Lịch sự hơn
rows: I want to ask you something.
I wanted to ask you something.
I wonder if you can help.
I was wondering if you could help.
I was hoping you could come.

examples.en: [[I was wondering if]] you could help me.
examples.vi: Không biết bạn có thể giúp tôi không.
examples.why: Quá khứ tiếp diễn: rất lịch sự.

examples.en: [[I wanted to]] ask about the job.
examples.vi: Tôi muốn hỏi về công việc.
examples.why: Quá khứ nhưng nói về bây giờ.

examples.vi: Anh có muốn uống cà phê không?
examples.why: Lời mời mềm mỏng hơn Do you want.

options: I was wondering if you could call me.
check.explain: Was wondering + could: nhẹ nhàng nhất.

sections.heading: I'd hoped, I'd planned, I was going to
sections.rule: **had hoped / had planned / was going to** = đã mong / đã định, **nhưng có lẽ không thành**. Dùng để nói khéo khi thất vọng hoặc từ chối.

examples.en: [[I'd hoped]] to see you at the party.
examples.vi: Tôi đã mong gặp bạn ở bữa tiệc.
examples.why: Had hoped: mong mà không thành.

examples.en: [[We had planned]] to launch in May, but…
examples.vi: Chúng tôi đã định ra mắt tháng Năm, nhưng…
examples.why: Kế hoạch có thể thay đổi.

check.prompt: I ___ to finish today, but the system crashed.
check.explain: Mong mà không thành → had hoped.

sections.heading: Would, could, might trong lời đề nghị
sections.rule: **Would you mind…?, Could you possibly…?, It might be better to…** làm lời nhờ và góp ý **mềm** hơn. Thêm **just, possibly, perhaps** càng lịch sự.

examples.vi: Anh có thể gửi nó hôm nay được không ạ?
examples.why: Possibly làm lời nhờ mềm hơn.

examples.en: [[It might be better to]] wait a few days.
examples.vi: Có lẽ nên đợi vài ngày.
examples.why: Góp ý khéo thay cho You should wait.

options: It might be better to ask first.
check.explain: It might be better to…: lời khuyên mềm.

mistakes.wrong: I am wondering if you can lend me your car.
mistakes.right: I was wondering if you could lend me your car.
mistakes.why: Lùi thì để lịch sự: was wondering + could.

mistakes.wrong: I was hoping you can help.
mistakes.right: I was hoping you could help.

mistakes.wrong: I hoped to see you, but you weren't there.
mistakes.right: I had hoped to see you, but you weren't there.
mistakes.why: Mong trước đó, không thành → had hoped.

mistakes.wrong: Could you possible send me the file?
mistakes.right: Could you possibly send me the file?

mistakes.wrong: Do you mind to wait a moment?
mistakes.right: Would you mind waiting a moment?
mistakes.why: Mind + V-ing; would lịch sự hơn.

exercises.prompt: I ___ if you had time for a quick chat.
We ___ to move house this year, but prices went up.
exercises.explain: Kế hoạch không thành → had planned.

exercises.prompt: I was hoping you ___ join us for dinner.

options: Perhaps you might change the title.

exercises.prompt: I ___ to ask you a favor.
answers: wanted

exercises.prompt: We'd ___ to finish by noon, but there were problems.
answers: hoped
exercises.explain: Had hoped: mong mà không thành.

exercises.prompt: Could you ___ check this for me?
answers: possibly
just

exercises.prompt: I was wondering ___ you were free on Sunday.
answers: if
whether

exercises.vi: Không biết bạn có thể giúp tôi không.
Tôi đã mong được gặp anh ấy.

exercises.sentence: I am wondering if you can call me back.
answers: I was wondering if you could call me back.

exercises.sentence: Would you mind to close the door?
answers: Would you mind closing the door?

exercises.sentence: I was hoping you will come.
answers: I was hoping you would come.

exercises.vi: Tôi muốn hỏi liệu tôi có thể nghỉ thứ Hai không.
answers: I was wondering if I could take Monday off.
I was wondering whether I could take Monday off.
I wanted to ask if I could take Monday off.
I wanted to ask whether I could take Monday off.
I was wondering if I could have Monday off.
I was wondering if I could take a day off on Monday.

exercises.vi: Chúng tôi đã định đi Sa Pa nhưng trời mưa.
answers: We had planned to go to Sa Pa, but it rained.
We'd planned to go to Sa Pa, but it rained.
We had planned to go to Sapa, but it rained.
We were going to go to Sa Pa, but it rained.
We had planned to visit Sa Pa, but it rained.
We were going to go to Sapa, but it rained.
exercises.explain: Kế hoạch không thành → had planned.
